name: Introduction to Digital Marketing Practical
objectives: Understand the applications of Digital Marketing.
Undertake marketing campaigns in digital format and apply the tools of Digital Marketing to gain competitive advantage in the market.
Analyze consumer buying behavior using Web Analytics and offer the right products or services to the right customers.
outcomes: CO1 Learn digital marketing tools like search engine optimization and associated analytics.

CO2 Apply digital marketing tools to (a) improve websites' rankings and optimize them, (b) improve the brand's visibility, (c) improve brand reach which physically is relatively difficult and less effective.
CO3 Analyze the relative importance of digital marketing strategies to optimize a digital marketing campaign.
CO4 Evaluate the performance of different social media in conjunction with the overall digital marketing plan.
CO5 Design search engine optimization and search engine marketing campaigns.
text: "Digital Marketing" By Vandana Ahuja, Publisher- Oxford University Press.
"Digital Marketing Strategy- An integrated approach to online marketing" by Simon Kingsnorth, Publisher- Kogan Page.
"Digital Marketing- A practical approach" by Alan Charlesworth, Publisher: Routledge - Taylor & Francis Group.
ref: Learning websites: http://www.books.google.co.in/Digital Marketing ; http://www.investopedia.com ; http://www.neilpatel.com ; different social media websites
note: Pre-requisite: basic knowledge of computer and internet.

exps.title: Digital Marketing Implementation in Business Scenario
exps.aim: Pick a business case and outline how digital channels are used to reach its customers.
exps.formula: Funnel: Awareness → Interest → Consideration → Purchase → Loyalty
viva: What is digital marketing?
Promotion of products or services through digital channels such as search, social media, email and websites.
Name main digital channels.
SEO, SEM, social media, email, content and display advertising.

exps.title: Create the Digital Marketing Webpage
exps.aim: Build a simple landing page for a product with a clear call to action.
exps.apparatus: Website builder (Wix / WordPress / Google Sites) or HTML editor, images, browser
exps.formula: Landing page = headline + benefits + visuals + call to action (CTA)
viva: What is a landing page?
A focused page where visitors arrive from an ad or link, designed for one action.
What is a CTA?
A prompt such as 'Buy now' or 'Sign up' that tells visitors what to do.

exps.title: Conducting the Search Engine Optimization and Search Engine Marketing
exps.aim: Optimise a page with keywords and set up a sample paid search campaign.
exps.apparatus: Google Keyword Planner, Google Ads (demo), SEO checker, browser
exps.formula: CTR = clicks / impressions × 100; CPC = cost / clicks
viva: Difference between SEO and SEM?
SEO earns organic ranking by optimising the site; SEM buys paid placement in search results.
What are on-page SEO elements?
Title, meta description, headings, keywords, alt text and internal links.

exps.title: Using Google Analytics to analyze website performance
exps.aim: Study traffic, source, bounce rate and audience reports of a website.
exps.apparatus: Google Analytics account or demo account, browser
exps.formula: Bounce rate = single-page sessions / total sessions × 100; Conversion rate = conversions / visitors × 100
viva: What is bounce rate?
Percentage of visits that leave after viewing one page.
What is a session?
A group of user interactions on a site within a time frame.

exps.title: Creating Promotional banner through Canva
exps.aim: Design a promotional banner with text, image and brand colours.
exps.formula: Design principles: contrast, alignment, hierarchy, white space
viva: Why use a consistent brand palette?
It builds recognition and trust.
Which size is chosen for a Facebook banner?
Use the platform's recommended dimensions, e.g. Facebook cover 820 × 312 px.

exps.title: Facebook Promotion using banners
exps.aim: Create a business page and publish or boost a banner post.
exps.apparatus: Facebook page, Meta Ads Manager (demo), banner from Canva
exps.formula: CPM = cost / impressions × 1000; reach = unique people who saw the post
viva: Difference between reach and impressions?
Reach counts unique viewers; impressions count total views.
What is boosting a post?
Paying to show a post to a wider targeted audience.

exps.title: Creating YouTube Channel for Marketing
exps.aim: Set up a channel, upload a promotional video and optimise title, tags and thumbnail.
exps.apparatus: Google account, YouTube Studio, video/screen recorder
exps.formula: Watch time and click-through rate drive video ranking
viva: Why optimise video titles and tags?
They help YouTube search recommend the video.
What is a thumbnail?
The preview image that attracts viewers to click.

exps.title: Twitter Marketing
exps.aim: Create a profile, post with hashtags and study engagement.
viva: Use of hashtags?
They group content by topic and increase discoverability.
What is engagement?
Interactions with a post such as likes, comments and shares.

exps.title: Instagram Marketing
exps.aim: Create a business profile and plan posts, reels and stories.
exps.formula: Content mix plan: posts, reels, stories, with a posting calendar
viva: What is an influencer?
A person with a following who promotes brands to their audience.
Why use stories and reels?
They give short, high-visibility formats with high engagement.

exps.title: Email Marketing
exps.aim: Create a mailing list and send a designed campaign email.
exps.apparatus: Mailchimp / Gmail, email template, contact list
exps.formula: Open rate = opened / delivered × 100; CTR = clicks / delivered × 100
viva: What is an email subject line for?
It decides whether the recipient opens the message.
What does opt-in mean?
Recipients give consent before receiving marketing mail.

exps.title: Digital Marketing Final Analysis and Report
exps.aim: Compile results from all channels into a final analysis report.
viva: What is ROI?
Return on investment: the profit from a campaign relative to its cost.
Which metrics go into the report?
Reach, engagement, CTR, conversions and cost per result.
